replay_contract.model: Inherit the byte-frozen Stage-C exact-V8 accepted-source replay, daily stressed-balance volume ladder, lot rounding, conservative capital and component accounting without modification.
replay_contract.actual_cost_book: Use recorded actual lifecycle net only.
replay_contract.stressed_cost_book: Use the already recorded doubled-observed-cost lifecycle net only; fit no new cost model.
replay_contract.fresh_block_rule: Every block independently starts at $100 with clean causal state and no capital or state carried from another block.
replay_contract.whole_rule: The whole period is one separate continuous replay from $100 and clean state; no block reset enters it.

economic_gates.block_gate: Every one of the six candidate blocks must have actual net > 0, stressed net > 0, minimum balance > 0 and actual closed-balance DD <= 30%.
economic_gates.whole_gate: Candidate whole stressed net must retain at least 75% of the exact-V8 whole anchor and candidate actual closed-balance DD must be at least five percentage points lower than the exact-V8 whole anchor.
economic_gates.passing_role: The immutable role passes only when every block gate and both whole gates pass. A locked-block failure cannot select an alternate or reopen Stage C.
economic_gates.ranking: If more than one role were present, maximize weakest block stressed net, then whole stressed-net-to-DD efficiency, whole stressed net, lower whole DD and canonical role order. With one immutable role, ranking cannot substitute another role.

succession.pass: Exactly one unchanged passing role opens conditional Stage E as the sole finalist.
succession.nonconfirmation: If the immutable role fails, close U002 validly exhausted with no Stage-E role and zero MT5; do not open an adjacent threshold, subgroup, component, state or retained-seed rescue.

input_staging_boundary: No Stage-D input, config, implementation, locked-block outcome or whole result may be created until this declaration commit is verified on origin/main.
